latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the user-research skill.

- Guides SaaS and startup founders through designing effective user research.
- Starts each session with key discovery questions to tailor the research plan.
- Provides ready-made interview scripts and survey design guidance for a variety of user types.
- Recommends actionable feedback loop setups and analysis frameworks.
- Supplies an action checklist and curated further reading/resources for ongoing learning.
